slots.notes: Hero background video filling a portrait 640:820 frame (absolute inset-0 object-cover), behind a bottom-fading dark gradient and the centered brand block + Instrument Serif headline + Enroll Now pill; autoplays, muted, loops, playsInline.

Two landscape feature-section video cards (one in TransformSection, one in RoadmapSection), w-full h-[370px] object-cover inside a rounded-[14px] overflow-hidden group anchor; each scales 1.03 on hover. Autoplay, muted, loop, playsInline.

Display serif (Instrument Serif, ital 0,1) loaded from Google Fonts and wired to --font-display; applied via inline fontFamily on every large heading, the hero brand wordmark, and the footer wordmark.
Body/UI sans (Inter, weights 400/500/600/700) loaded from Google Fonts and wired to --font-body as the document default; carries all paragraphs, step text, button labels, microcopy, and footer links.
lucide-react ArrowRight glyph (w-5 h-5, strokeWidth 2.5) trailing the primary lime CTA pills; rendered in the dark on-lime text color via currentColor.

Footer social-row glyphs (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Youtube, Linkedin, Music2) from lucide-react at w-[18px] h-[18px], each in a 40px circular bordered button that inverts to dark-on-white on hover; tinted via currentColor.

mechanic: A 640px email card stacks a portrait video-background hero (object-cover video under a bottom-darkening linear-gradient with the headline anchored to the base) above alternating feature sections whose rounded video cards scale to 1.03 on group-hover, closing on a lime CTA card and a social footer; all CTAs lift -translate-y-0.5 with a background-color shift on hover.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS (CSS variables for fonts) with Google Fonts and lucide-react icons; headings styled via inline fontFamily.
reskinNotes: Two distinct lime accents are used inconsistently (card components on #DCFF00, hero pill + lime CTA card + hover wordmark on #D8F90A / #1E1E1E text), so a single accent token will not faithfully reproduce the original unless both are mapped. The hero overlay gradient hardcodes rgba(17,17,17,...) stops matching the #111111 card surface, so changing the surface color requires editing those gradient stops too. All copy (brand name, headline, all section paragraphs, the four numbered steps, Microsoft disclaimer, unsubscribe note, nav links, and the dated SF-address copyright) is hardcoded in JSX. The hero frame is a fixed 640:820 aspect ratio, so a non-portrait brand video will be cropped. Social icons and the CTA arrow are lucide-react component glyphs (not swappable image assets) selected in markup.
